title: Muscle Strength Evaluations in Ankylosing Spondylitis
brief_summary: This study evaluates how the trunk and proximal girdle muscles are affected in male patients with ankylosing spondylitis, compared to healthy controls.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Having a diagnosis of ankylosing spondylitis according to Modified NewYork criteria
2. Being male
3. Aged ≥18

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Severe cardiac or pulmonary or renal disease
2. Accompanying fibromyalgia
3. Severe psychiatric disorder
4. Other disease limiting spinal, shoulder or hip range of motion
5. Myopathy, neuropathy or radiculopathy that may cause muscle weakness
6. Using high dose steroids
7. Endocrinological disorders
8. Malignancy
9. Pregnancy
study_population: Controls: Healthy volunteers meeting inclusion criteria accepting to participate Ankylosing spondylitis group: Ankylosing spondylitis patients meeting inclusion criteria accepting to participate
